name: Auto Deco AI
description: Prompt-driven AI placement for glow and shine decorations in the Geometry Dash editor.

api-endpoint.name: Chat completions endpoint
api-endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. For local Ollama, replace YOUR-MAC-IP with your Mac's Wi-Fi IP address.

api-model.name: Model
api-model.description: Model name installed in Ollama (default is a small local model).

api-key.name: API key
api-key.description: Optional for a local Ollama server. Leave blank for the local setup; only use keys for providers you are authorized to use.
